| GNN conformance | inline workflow bash; not runnable locally as one command | `gnn`: 2.7 s | arm provisions the pinned revision, then runs the conformance tests against it |

| types | no job; mypy src: 640 errors in 83 files | `types`: 0.3 s | arm covers src/core/gnn.py, the annotated loader surface |
| docs index and relative links | nothing existed; no mkdocs, no link-check config | `docs`: 0.4 s | index is generated from docs/; link check is offline and skips tool-generated trees |
| static-analysis debt | nothing recorded | `debt`: 28.2 s | publishes flake8, black, isort and mypy counts into this page |
| CI environments per gate run | 5 (four suite legs plus the GNN job) | — | now 2 jobs; each creates one locked environment and calls ./run.sh only |

## Static-analysis debt

These counts are measured, not gated. `./run.sh lint` blocks only syntax and
undefined-name errors; the wider style findings are recorded here so the debt is
visible and cannot silently grow unnoticed.

| Check | Command | Findings |
| --- | --- | --- |
| flake8 (all rules) | `flake8 --max-line-length=100 --extend-ignore=E203,W503 --max-complexity=10 src` | 9508 |
| black --check | `black --check src tests beyond_cerebrum/src` | 247 |
| isort --check-only | `isort --check-only --profile black --line-length 100 src tests beyond_cerebrum/src` | 187 |
| mypy src/ | `mypy src` | 640 |
